consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly praise the 10/30/1980 show at Radio City Music Hall for its exceptional performance and unique setlist, highlighting the seamless blend of acoustic and electric elements. The energy of the band, particularly during the guest appearance of Billy Cobham, adds to the legendary status of this concert.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 22 reviews + 1.5 sentiment: The high praise for the performance quality and standout moments, along with the emotional connection fans have to this show, significantly boosts the overall sentiment.
